title: T1078.003 — Valid Accounts - Local Accounts
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Valid Accounts - Local Accounts with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.
aria: Animated diagram: an attacker harvests the local admin password from a compromised laptop, logs on to several servers by remote desktop, installs a fake backup service, sweeps the subnet, and the SOC correlates the events and responds by isolating hosts and rotating passwords.

steps.title: Entry
steps.caption: The attacker sends an employee a fake installer. The employee runs it, and the attacker gets code execution on the laptop WKS-0231 as a normal user. Nothing about local accounts has happened yet - but the way in is open
steps.defender: IdP and SaaS audit logs record token issuance, consent, sign-in location and API access.

steps.title: Harvest
steps.caption: From the laptop, the attacker runs a small tool that reads the SAM database, the protected file that stores every local password hash. From those hashes the attacker recovers the password of the local admin account svc-backup . Any read of the SAM should be treated as credential theft
steps.defender: IdP and SaaS audit logs record token issuance, consent, sign-in location and API access.
